bio: Paula Heister is a doctor, scientist, author, and illustrator who currently teaches medicine at Downing College, University of Cambridge. She will produce a children’s book dealing with the challenging concept of death, engaging with both the science and practicalities of it as well as its emotional impact and cultural significance.
